notes: Read SKILL.md and references/capabilities.md, references/non-hero-scenarios.md in full. Python reference for Azure AI Document Translation (azure-ai-translation-document): batch translation between Blob containers, multiple targets, single-document translation, job/document status, cancel, glossaries, supported formats, async client and SAS storage requirements.

Medium only because SKILL.md:20 tells the agent to `pip install azure-ai-translation-document` (official PyPI package, unpinned). All service calls use DefaultAzureCredential (or legacy AzureKeyCredential from an environment variable) in Python sample code for the user's application; the single-document sample reads document.docx and writes document_es.docx in the user's code. The agent is not told to call the service, read secrets, or run anything else.

Inconsistency: SKILL.md:240-248 calls client.get_supported_languages() on DocumentTranslationClient, while references/non-hero-scenarios.md:66-82 says that method does not exist and uses TextTranslationClient (azure-ai-translation-text, not in the install line) instead. Container URLs embed SAS tokens; users should treat them as secrets.
